text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I win a ticket to an Umamusume martial
arts show
during a shopping trip.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hoping to learn a thing or two, I go to
watch.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I'm leaving. I'd be better off lifting
weights
myself than watching this.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Why make assumptions when the
match
hasn't even begun?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So much for "performing an
observation-based analysis of athletic
aptitude concerning muscular
fitness."
The heck is all this?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I only care about running. I'm not
watching some
primitive fistfight.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you wanted to sit around sipping juice,
enjoying
shows—you should've brought a
friend.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I think both races and fights share a
commonality
in the sense they both
require physical movement.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hah, please.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... hey! Everyone here is crowding me
in—I
can't leave like this.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But of course!
It's a really popular match. Rather
than worrying about the turnout,
turn your gaze to this Umamusume
fighter. What a body!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I have some hypotheses as to how she
developed those muscles, but I wonder
how she will use
them... This is so
exciting!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, are you listening to me?! Tch, I
guess I have
no other choice...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the match begins.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The show of power and speed at hand
scales far
beyond human limits. The
crowd is stirred into a
frenzy.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What did you think, Shakur?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Their physical coordination was
next-level.
Whatever they're doing to
train, it's better than
any method I know.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Makes me wonder how they'd do in a
race. They wouldn't beat me, obviously,
but I bet they'd put
up a decent
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I see, I see! And?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I guess... regardless of your path, all
athletes are
fighting an uphill battle with
their physical limits, trying to climb the
mountain to the top.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Trying to reach the top of one's own
mountain,
eh? Now that's poetic! Tell me
what else you've
learned.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Tch. I've already said too much.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'm outta here.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And where do you think you're going?
I'm sure
there are a few more poems
inside you. Please, I'd
love to hear more!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Would you just shut up for once?!
